alliance.abilityText: Gain a Province, a Duchy, an Estate, a Gold, a Silver, and a Copper.

banish.abilityText: Exile any number of cards with the same name from your hand.

bargain.abilityText: Gain a non-Victory card costing up to $5. Each other player gains a Horse.

commerce.abilityText: Gain a Gold per differently named card you've gained this turn.

delay.abilityText: You may set aside an Action card from your hand. At the start of your next turn, play it.

demand.abilityText: Gain a Horse and a card costing up to $4, both onto your deck.

desperation.abilityText: Once per turn: You may gain a Curse. If you do, +1 Buy and +$2.

enclave.abilityText: Gain a Gold. Exile a Duchy from the Supply.

enhance.abilityText: You may trash a non-Victory card from your hand, to gain a card costing up to $2 more than it.

gamble.abilityText:
+1 Buy
Discard the top card of your deck. If it's an Action or Treasure, you may play it.

invest.abilityText: Exile an Action card from the Supply. While it's in Exile, when another player gains or Invests in a copy of it, +2 Cards.

march.abilityText: Look through your discard pile. You may play an Action card from it.

populate.abilityText: Gain one card from each Action Supply pile.

pursue.abilityText:
+1 Buy
Name a card. Reveal the top 4 cards from your deck. Put the matches back and discard the rest.

reap.abilityText: Gain a Gold, setting it aside. At the start of your next turn, play it.

seize-the-day.abilityText: Once per game: Take an extra turn after this one.

stampede.abilityText: If you have 5 or fewer cards in play, gain 5 Horses onto your deck.

toil.abilityText:
+1 Buy
You may play an Action card from your hand.

transport.abilityText: Choose one: Exile an Action card from the Supply; or put an Action card you have in Exile onto your deck.
